messages:
anya: Quick alignment thread  Optimize toolkit pilot acceptance for batching/caching/quant recommendations + eval-triggered alerts. We need deterministic gates for launch.

marcus: I'll keep this concise. Propose 5 gates: latency, batching health, econ uplift, quant safety, eval-alert reliability.

evie: include tenant-level control and auditability too. enterprise customers ask for that a lot.

nora: For batching health, propose avg batch size >= 5 and peak tail queue latency < 15ms so batching doesn't add visible tail.

anya: Draft acceptance language:

```
Optimize toolkit pilot acceptance (v0.2):
- Latency SLOs: p95 <= 280ms for seq_len <512, p95 <= 420ms for seq_len >=512, measured on Dedicated pilot hardware with warmed KV-cache where applicable.
- Batching & cache health: average batch size >= 5 on batched routes; warmed KV-cache hit rate >= 65% on cacheable flows; queue tail latency for batching <= 15ms at 95th percentile.
- Economic uplift: median per-token unit cost reduction >= 13% on anonymized pilot traffic replay (seeded 10k prompts), with no allowed quality regressions.
- Quantization safety: quant variants must not cause >2.5% absolute drop on primary eval metric across the core prompt set.
- Eval-triggered alerts: detection sensitivity = >6% relative drop over 1k eval samples or 24h; FP rate <= 6% and FN rate <= 10% on labeled regression sets; adjustable thresholds per-customer.
- Tenant controls: tenants can opt into auto-apply, recommend-only, or opt-out. All applied recommendations must generate an audit log entry and per-tenant rollback capability.
- Rollout & fallback: canary rollout at 4% traffic, automatic fallback to compatible variant on runtime incompatibility with metric emitted, auto-rollback on sustained SLO breach >5 minutes.
- Telemetry: pilot retention 14 days, ability to attach 3 trace samples to each alert for debugging.
```

marcus: looks good. add note: econ measurement requires both replay and live A/B run for at least 6 hours.

evie: I'll own tenant UX snippet + audit log requirements. nora: can you own batching queue tests?

nora: yes, will produce stress test results and queue tail metrics by Thu EOD (1925008000).

anya: owners: marcus (econ harness), evie (tenant UX + audit), nora (batching tests). Drop artifacts into the ticket by the agreed dates.

ops-bot: Deploy window reminder: Fri 09:00 UTC for the pilot cluster.

anya: Thanks team  I'll paste these gates into the roadmap doc and label owners. Short thread, ready to move to ticket. :rocket:
